mechanism: Both drugs have nephrotoxic potential; leflunomide's active metabolite (A77 1726) undergoes renal elimination and gentamicin is a known aminoglycoside nephrotoxin, increasing risk of acute kidney injury when combined.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; assess baseline renal function before initiating combination therapy.
